actionDefinitions.intent: Preserve an exact versioned structural selection as a named site
Offer versioned work and an acceptance contract to a target scope
Accept accountable ownership of a handoff under its permission envelope
Promote one exact molecular proposal under the active identity policy
Add an existing canonical compound to a versioned campaign objective

requirements.condition: any read, offer, preview, commit, share, export, cache, AI, or telemetry operation
requirements.behavior: reauthorize at the application boundary with field and relationship filtering
requirements.failure: return a non-leaking refusal or tombstone
requirements.evidence: authoritative integration plus cross-tenant adversarial tests

requirements.condition: an entity appears in more than one workspace
requirements.behavior: project the same canonical reference and version without recreation
requirements.failure: block ambiguous or duplicate creation and return safe identity outcome

requirements.condition: tenant, Program, WorkThread, question, or parent object changes
requirements.behavior: apply typed transition and invalidation rules before rendering descendants
requirements.failure: clear or tombstone invalid descendants without leaking labels
requirements.evidence: context transition capability and revocation tests

requirements.condition: context is shared or restored
requirements.behavior: use an opaque expiring handle and reauthorize before labels are shown
requirements.failure: show a safe unavailable state
requirements.evidence: share-link revocation and URL inspection tests

requirements.condition: a user selects objects, substructures, material, wells, or data
requirements.behavior: create the matching typed SelectionRef with versions, scope, lifecycle, and size
requirements.authority: projection for transient state; application for named/shared state
requirements.failure: refuse unsupported or stale selection semantics

requirements.condition: a surface reports work or data state
requirements.behavior: preserve draft, connectivity, availability, submission, execution, freshness, and review as orthogonal axes
requirements.failure: display unknown rather than inventing a combined status

requirements.condition: an actor asks what can be done
requirements.behavior: request authoritative ActionOffers for stable versioned application action IDs
requirements.failure: return permission-safe absence or structured ineligibility

requirements.condition: a consequential action is prepared
requirements.behavior: return a server-computed preview, signed precondition token, source versions, effects, warnings, and acknowledgements
requirements.failure: refuse preview when truth or authorization is incomplete

requirements.condition: an actor commits a preview
requirements.behavior: reauthorize and compare token/source versions before transaction or declared saga
requirements.failure: return stale semantic diff, refusal, or per-effect compensation receipt
requirements.evidence: stale, partial-effect, and revocation integration tests

requirements.condition: transport repeats the same request
requirements.behavior: reuse one operation and receipt for the same idempotency key and payload digest
requirements.failure: refuse key reuse with a different payload

requirements.condition: a scientist deliberately retries work
requirements.behavior: create a new attempt ID linked to the prior attempt
requirements.failure: do not collapse scientific retry into transport deduplication

requirements.condition: scientific work splits, merges, delegates, supersedes, returns, or shares dependencies
requirements.behavior: represent the transition as typed WorkThread graph nodes and edges
requirements.failure: refuse invalid cycles or unauthorized edge disclosure

requirements.condition: work crosses role, team, service, partner, or stage
requirements.behavior: use versioned lifecycle, frozen/live payloads, acceptance contract, permission envelope, SLA, escalation, and partial delivery
requirements.failure: derive structured missing clauses and allow reject/return/cancel/supersede

requirements.condition: work needs a response
requirements.behavior: create a permission-filtered AttentionItem with subject, reason, due window, actions, versions, and dedupe key
requirements.failure: deduplicate or expire safely; never leak subject existence

requirements.condition: work is delegated to an agent
requirements.behavior: issue a bounded DelegationEnvelope and require receipts, evidence, and calibrated/uncalibrated/unknown uncertainty
requirements.failure: refuse scope expansion and gated consequences

requirements.condition: material is reserved, split, transferred, consumed, or released
requirements.behavior: enforce unit-aware conservation, reservation version, custody, container, location, and QC
requirements.failure: atomically refuse double-spend, unit mismatch, quarantine, or stale version

requirements.condition: a primary journey is offered
requirements.actor: keyboard, screen-reader, touch, or low-motion user
requirements.behavior: provide component-specific semantic operation without drag, hover, colour, or animation dependence
requirements.failure: block release of that journey until equivalent operation and feedback exist
requirements.evidence: manual protocol plus automated semantics tests

requirements.condition: a performance claim or release budget is evaluated
requirements.behavior: record workload, fixture, hardware, browser, network, cold/warm state, percentile, TTFUS, feedback, memory, and progress accuracy as applicable
requirements.failure: report not_recorded rather than a fabricated value

requirements.condition: a telemetry event is introduced or emitted
requirements.behavior: classify purpose, fields, tenant, retention, access, opt-out, and environment without scientific content by default
requirements.failure: drop unapproved fields/events and audit the refusal

requirements.condition: a Program question is active
requirements.behavior: project WorkThread graph as next-actions, graph, board, Gantt uncertainty, and decision evidence
requirements.failure: show permission-safe partialness and stale evidence

requirements.condition: a structural interpretation is saved or handed off
requirements.behavior: preserve exact structure version, model, assembly, chain, residue, atom, altloc, and snapshot semantics
requirements.failure: return mapping ambiguity or stale diff rather than silently remapping

requirements.condition: a molecular proposal is promoted
requirements.behavior: preserve draft version, stereochemistry, isotope, tautomer/protonation policy, form, lineage, and duplicate outcome
requirements.failure: branch concurrent edits and safely report inaccessible duplicates

requirements.condition: candidates are compared or advanced
requirements.behavior: bind scores to objective version and preview mixed eligibility for explicit or derived sets
requirements.failure: exclude/unknown groups remain visible and cannot be coerced to eligible

requirements.condition: an experiment is planned or started
requirements.behavior: preserve protocol/layout versions, wells, dilutions, randomization, blinding, schedule, sample quantities, deviations, and QC
requirements.failure: return well-level conflict or atomic resource refusal

requirements.condition: evidence is searched, admitted, superseded, or retracted
requirements.behavior: use permission-safe graph queries and propagate freshness/invalidation to dependants
requirements.failure: avoid count/timing leakage and show safe tombstones
requirements.evidence: large graph, retraction, and leak tests

requirements.condition: compute is submitted, retried, cancelled, or returned
requirements.behavior: preserve Mission, Run, Attempt, Job, environment, quota, provenance, and result validity as distinct concepts
requirements.failure: resolve cancellation race and invalid result with explicit receipt

requirements.condition: a requirement is claimed implemented
requirements.behavior: link requirement ID to capability, authoritative integration, E2E, manual, and adversarial evidence required by its risk
requirements.failure: keep status designed/reference-tested/integrated instead of complete
